messages:
rowan: quick alert canary embeddings p95 climbed to ~710ms over the last 9m, deploybot flagged it.
deploybot: [signal] embed-canary p95=710ms (threshold=600ms); autorevert=false; recommend: reduce traffic or manual rollback.
mike: any correlation with the new micro-quant patch from last night?
cel: logs show a spike of `kvcache: miss` and a couple of pod restarts. Could be both.
rowan: runbook check: if p95>threshold for 10m OR customer errors rise, do manual rollback and pin.
ops-oncall-bot: runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback  If rollback >20m notify #cust-impact.
mike: we have ~9m now. I'd vote manual rollback to v3.5.2 (known stable) and soft-pin dedicated pools.
cel: agreed. We'll do a staged rollback for canary only, pin pools, and open a tracking ticket. Who's executing? @cel happy to run.
rowan: go for it. Pause canary first.
deploybot: action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-embed --by=rowan`
rowan: paused. Cel, we're ready.
cel: executing staged revert: `rollout revert --target=canary-embed --to-version=v3.5.2 --staged=3 --reason="perf spike"`
deploybot: stage 1/3 ok. p95 dropped to 380ms on host-1.
cel: pinning dedicated pools to v3.5.2: `service.pin_version('embedders','v3.5.2')` done.
deploybot: rollback completed for canary-embed. metadata updated: release_state=reverted, pinned_version=v3.5.2, operator=cel
ops-oncall-bot: opened ticket ROLLBACK-2024-0417 for tracking. Postmortem owner: mike. Suggested actions: revert micro-quant PR from canary, add KV warmup step, add canary gate on kv-hit.
rowan: drafting short release-note blurb and a customer-facing sentence: "Observed performance instability in embeddings canary; briefly reverted to a prior stable build while we investigate."
mike: will add postmortem items to backlog. Monitoring window 15m.
rowan: monitoring looks stable so far (p95 ~420ms, kv-hit ~92%). Closing thread unless regression. :thumbsup:
